description.en:
LimX Oli is a full-size humanoid platform for embodied-intelligence research and application development. The manufacturer describes a 165 cm body with 31 body degrees of freedom, designed for coordinated movement, manipulation and interaction with the surrounding environment.

Its modular hardware and software support a workflow from algorithm development through simulation and deployment on the robot. LimX identifies gait planning, dexterous manipulation, multimodal interaction and reinforcement learning as research uses. The platform combines whole-body motion control with expandable sensing and development tools, allowing research teams and integrators to build their own applications.
